question: What is the parent technique of attack technique 'T1558.001: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Golden Ticket'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
Found ATT&CK record T1558.001: Golden Ticket. T1558.001 (Golden Ticket): Adversaries who have the KRBTGT account password hash may forge Kerberos ticket-granting tickets (TGT), also known as a golden ticket.(Citation: AdSecurity Kerberos GT Aug 2015) Golden tickets enable adversaries to generate authentication material for any account in Active Directory.(Citation: CERT-EU Golden Ticket Protection) 

Using a golden ticket, adversaries are then able to request ticket granting service (TGS) tickets, which enable access to specific resources. T1558.001 (Golden Ticket) has stix_type: attack-pattern; x_mitre_deprecated: False; x_mitre_is_subtechnique: True; x_mitre_version: 1.2.
